description: This PHP test class, DefaultTimesheetAPITest, extends EndpointIntegrationTestCase and contains unit tests for the DefaultTimesheetAPI class, verifying its methods such as getOne, delete, getValidationRuleForDelete, update, and getValidationRuleForUpdate.

classes.name: DefaultTimesheetAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the DefaultTimesheetAPI's functionality and API endpoints within the OrangeHRM time management plugin.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests the API's getOne method, verifying correct behavior with various test cases.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetOne
methods.description: Provides test data for the testGetOne method, sourcing cases from a YAML file.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Verifies that calling delete() throws a NotImplementedException.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Checks that the validation rule retrieval for delete returns expected results or exceptions.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Verifies that calling update() is not implemented and throws the expected exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Checks the validation rules associated with update operations.
